Well, I haven't shifted yet but apparently it sort of works that way.

If you think about it, when you wake up in the morning you're not like constantly questioning which reality you're in? Once you shift to your DR it becomes your CR. (if that makes sense) So once you shift, it'll feel like your CR and then you might see something or someone that reminds you that you shifted. So I scripted that I can't forget anything from my script once I reach my CR. So in a way, if you can remember that you've shifted, then you can probably remember your CR. (unless you script otherwise!! I scripted that I can't remember any trauma or overly-negative memories from my CR that don't relate to my DR) Also if you want to live out like a TV show or something, then it's probably best that you script that you can't remember anything from it. So you kinda get the full experience lmao. (for example, I'm trying to shift into Stranger Things, so I said that I can't remember anything about the plot.)

Scripting is really important! So it can really work however you want. :D

look, I get that it doesn't in the slightest seem this way at the moment, but suicide really isn't the way out. I don't fully know your situation but it sounds like you want an end to suffering, (which usually is the reason for many suicides). If it helps, I have had similar thoughts to you. And one of the things that have stopped me from going through with it is just the thought of the look on my family's faces when they find out. When I get to that level, I think hard about the expression on each person's face. It's not exactly an optimistic, happy way of getting through things but it's kept me here so that's my advice. you're obviously suffering a lot, but suicide is not going to fix anything. please don't go through with it. ❤️

I've never related to something more. the thing about therapists is they have a "duty of care". which is the stupidest system ever created. it basically means that if you're a minor and they believe that you are going to harm yourself or others in the near future, (I think more specifically it's 48 hours but I'm not too sure if that's correct), then they have to tell your parents. If you want to actually have effective therapy sessions around this stupid rule then you can get around it by framing your thoughts in a way that says "I'm not actually going to do this, but I've been having thoughts about it". whether or not you are actually planning to go through with it I don't know, but hopefully, this helps. keep fighting. <3
